words.enDefinition: Field concerned with measuring psychological attributes and evaluating those measurements

examples.en: Our psychometrics seminar starts by asking what a questionnaire score actually represents.
examples.zh: 我们的「心理测量学」研讨课从问卷分数究竟代表什么讲起。

examples.en: The textbook introduces psychometrics through several examples using invented scores and responses.
examples.zh: 教材用虚构分数和作答数据的几个例子介绍「心理测量学」。

words.enDefinition: Systematic evaluation combining information about a person's psychological functioning or attributes

examples.en: The class uses a fictional case to examine the sources of information in psychological assessment.
examples.zh: 课堂用虚构个案分析「心理评估」中的信息来源。

examples.en: We discussed how psychological assessment can draw on interviews as well as test results.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「心理评估」如何同时参考访谈和测验结果。

words.enDefinition: Structured procedure designed to sample behavior and measure a psychological attribute

examples.en: The workbook shows how a fictional psychological test samples performance on pattern problems.
examples.zh: 练习册展示了一个虚构的「心理测验」如何抽取图形规律题的作答表现。

examples.en: We discussed what a psychological test can tell us from a brief set of responses.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「心理测验」能从少量作答中反映什么。

words.enDefinition: Unobserved individual characteristic modeled along a scale using observed responses

examples.en: The model places each simulated respondent at a point on the latent trait scale.
examples.zh: 模型将各个模拟作答者放在「潜在特质」量尺上的某个位置。

examples.en: We discussed how an estimated latent trait differs from a directly observed answer.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了估计得出的「潜在特质」与直接观察到的回答有何不同。

words.enDefinition: Measured variable used to represent an attribute in a statistical model

examples.en: The diagram treats each recorded answer as an observed indicator of the proposed construct.
examples.zh: 示意图将每项记录下来的答案视为拟研究构念的一个「观测指标」。

examples.en: We discussed why an observed indicator can reflect influences outside the target construct.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么一个「观测指标」也可能反映目标构念以外的因素。

collocations: link an observed indicator to a factor

words.enDefinition: Statistical description linking observed measures to the attributes they represent

examples.en: The measurement model connects each of the questionnaire items with its intended factor.
examples.zh: 「测量模型」将每道问卷题与它意在反映的因子连接起来。

examples.en: Our group compared two versions of the measurement model using the same simulated responses.
examples.zh: 我们组用同一批模拟作答比较了两个版本的「测量模型」。

words.enDefinition: Range of relevant behaviors or content that a psychological measure should represent

examples.en: The workbook describes the construct domain before introducing the prototype questionnaire items.
examples.zh: 练习册先说明「构念范围」，再介绍问卷原型中的题目。

examples.en: We checked which parts of the construct domain were missing from the fictional scale.
examples.zh: 我们核对了虚构量表遗漏了「构念范围」中的哪些部分。

words.enDefinition: Collection of candidate items being considered for inclusion in a measure

examples.en: Our class reviewed an item pool containing several draft questions for each topic.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上审阅了一个「备选题集合」，每个主题下都有几道拟定的问题。

examples.en: We grouped the item pool by content before discussing possible versions of the test.
examples.zh: 我们按内容给「备选题集合」分类，再讨论测验的可能版本。

words.enDefinition: Organized repository of assessment items maintained for use in test development

examples.en: The simulated item bank stores practice questions along with their estimated difficulty levels.
examples.zh: 模拟「题库」储存了练习题和各题的估计难度。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how two sample forms drew from the same item bank.
examples.zh: 老师展示了两份样卷如何从同一个「题库」选题。

collocations: select items from an item bank

words.enDefinition: Plan specifying the content and skills an assessment should cover

examples.en: The test blueprint assigns space to pattern recognition and interpretation in the sample assessment.
examples.zh: 「测验蓝图」在样例测验中为规律识别和解释预留了题量。

examples.en: We checked the fictional questions against the topics listed in the test blueprint.
examples.zh: 我们将虚构题目与「测验蓝图」列出的主题逐一对照。

words.enDefinition: Specific version of a test containing a particular set of items

examples.en: The two versions share a topic, but each test form presents distinct questions.
examples.zh: 两个版本涵盖同一主题，但每份「测验卷本」的题目不同。

examples.en: We checked whether each test form covered every skill on the blueprint.
examples.zh: 我们检查了每份「测验卷本」是否涵盖蓝图上的所有技能。

words.enDefinition: Different versions of an assessment designed to measure the same attributes

examples.en: The workbook uses alternate forms with different questions drawn from the same blueprint.
examples.zh: 练习册使用贴合相同蓝图选题的「测验复本」，各卷题目有所不同。

examples.en: We compared alternate forms designed to cover the same aspects of the target skill.
examples.zh: 我们对比了拟覆盖目标技能相同方面的「测验复本」。

words.enDefinition: Conducting a test under consistent, specified instructions and conditions

examples.en: Both simulated sessions use the same instructions to illustrate standardized administration in the workbook.
examples.zh: 练习册中的两次模拟施测采用相同说明，以演示「标准化施测」。

examples.en: The class discussed how standardized administration supports more consistent comparisons across mock sessions.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了「标准化施测」如何让各次模拟施测之间的比较更一致。

words.enDefinition: Instrument that obtains information from respondents about their own experiences or behavior

examples.en: The fictional self-report measure asks participants to describe their own study habits.
examples.zh: 虚构的「自陈测量工具」请作答者描述自己的学习习惯。

examples.en: We compared a self-report measure of practice habits with a mock observation record.
examples.zh: 我们将一份关于练习习惯的「自陈测量工具」与模拟观察记录作了比较。

collocations: compare a self-report measure with observer ratings

words.enDefinition: Ordered scoring tool used to rate attributes based on observed behavior

examples.en: The fictional observer rating scale records judgments about how consistently a character completes tasks.
examples.zh: 虚构的「观察者评定量表」记录对角色完成任务是否稳定的判断。

examples.en: Our class compared the observer rating scale with reports from the fictional participants themselves.
examples.zh: 课堂把「观察者评定量表」与虚构作答者本人的报告作了比较。

collocations: scores on an observer rating scale

words.enDefinition: Rating scale whose score levels are defined by specific behavioral examples

examples.en: The behaviorally anchored rating scale describes what an observer might see at each level.
examples.zh: 「行为锚定评定量表」描述观察者在各个等级上可能看到的具体表现。

examples.en: Our group compared vague labels with the examples in a behaviorally anchored rating scale.
examples.zh: 我们组把含糊的等级标签和「行为锚定评定量表」中的具体例子相比较。

collocations: use a behaviorally anchored rating scale
construct a behaviorally anchored rating scale
score on a behaviorally anchored rating scale

words.enDefinition: Single statement rated on an ordered scale of agreement

examples.en: The demo presents one Likert item with ordered options from disagreement to agreement.
examples.zh: 演示给出一个「李克特式题项」，选项按从不同意到同意排列。

examples.en: We distinguished a single Likert item from the score across multiple related items.
examples.zh: 我们把单个「李克特式题项」与多道相关题目合成的得分区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Summated rating scale built from multiple items with ordered agreement options

examples.en: The sample Likert scale combines responses to several related classroom preference statements.
examples.zh: 示例「李克特量表」将有关课堂偏好的几项陈述的回答合在一起计分。

examples.en: We compared responses on one item with scores for the whole Likert scale.
examples.zh: 我们对比了单题的作答与整个「李克特量表」的分数。

words.enDefinition: Selection of an affirmative or higher agreement response to an item

examples.en: The table reports item endorsement for each statement in the simulated agreement questionnaire.
examples.zh: 表格报告了模拟态度问卷中每项陈述的「题项赞同」情况。

examples.en: We compared item endorsement across two statements dealing with the same classroom topic.
examples.zh: 我们比较了围绕同一课堂主题的两条陈述的「题项赞同」情况。

words.enDefinition: Response options with a meaningful order but no assumed equal spacing

examples.en: The example lists ordinal response categories from rarely to often without assuming equal gaps.
examples.zh: 例子将「有序作答类别」从很少到经常排列，并未假定各级间距相等。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why numbers assigned to ordinal response categories need not represent equal distances.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么给「有序作答类别」分配的数值并不一定表示相等的间距。

words.enDefinition: Labels or examples defining the meanings of points on a response scale

examples.en: The worksheet shows response anchors that describe what the ends of the scale mean.
examples.zh: 习题展示了说明量表两端含义的「作答等级锚点」。

examples.en: We compared two sets of response anchors for the same fictional item.
examples.zh: 我们对照了同一道虚构题目的两套「作答等级锚点」。

words.enDefinition: Selectable category positioned at the center of an ordered response scale

examples.en: The mock questionnaire includes a midpoint option labeled neither agree nor disagree.
examples.zh: 模拟问卷有一个标为既不赞同也不反对的「中点选项」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the midpoint option meant neutrality on this particular scale.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在这个量表中「中点选项」是否表示中立。

words.enDefinition: Item requiring selection between alternatives instead of independent ratings for each

examples.en: In the exercise, each forced-choice item asks students to choose between two statements.
examples.zh: 在练习中，每道「强迫选择题」要求学生在两项陈述之间作选择。

examples.en: The worksheet compares ratings of both statements with a single forced-choice item.
examples.zh: 习题比较了对两个陈述分别评分与做一道「强迫选择题」的区别。

words.enDefinition: Assessment item requiring the respondent to produce rather than select an answer

examples.en: The constructed-response item asks participants to explain the pattern in their own words.
examples.zh: 「建构反应题」要求作答者用自己的话解释规律。

examples.en: We discussed how the rubric handles different answers to one constructed-response item.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了评分标准如何处理同一道「建构反应题」的不同答案。

words.enDefinition: Assessment item with two possible scored outcomes, such as correct and incorrect

examples.en: The simulated dichotomous item awards one point for correct and zero for incorrect.
examples.zh: 模拟「二分题项」对答对计一分，对答错计零分。

examples.en: Our group compared a dichotomous item with a question allowing partial credit.
examples.zh: 我们组把一道「二分题项」和允许给部分分的题目作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Assessment item scored in more than two distinct response categories

examples.en: The rubric gives a polytomous item scores of zero, one, or two.
examples.zh: 评分标准给一道「多分题项」设定了零、一、二分。

examples.en: The tutorial explains how a polytomous item can award different levels of partial credit.
examples.zh: 辅导课说明了「多分题项」如何给不同等级的部分分。

words.enDefinition: Item whose numerical scoring runs opposite to its presented response order

examples.en: The scoring sheet shows how the point values change for a reverse-scored item.
examples.zh: 计分表展示了一道「反向计分题」的分值如何调整。

examples.en: We marked the reverse-scored item before comparing scores across the two sample versions.
examples.zh: 我们在比较两个示例版本的分数之前标出了「反向计分题」。

words.enDefinition: Tendency to agree with statements regardless of their specific content

examples.en: The simulated record illustrates acquiescent responding with agreement on both sides of an issue.
examples.zh: 模拟记录用对同一问题的正反两方都赞成来说明「赞同式作答」。

examples.en: We discussed whether acquiescent responding might account for agreement with contradictory statements.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「赞同式作答」能否解释对相互矛盾的陈述都表示赞同。

words.enDefinition: Tendency to prefer endpoints of a scale regardless of item content

examples.en: The fictional dataset illustrates extreme responding with repeated selection of the scale endpoints.
examples.zh: 虚构数据用反复选择量表两端选项的情形来说明「极端作答」。

examples.en: Our group discussed why extreme responding alone tells us little about the underlying opinions.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了为什么只知道有「极端作答」，并不能充分了解实际看法。

words.enDefinition: Repeating the same response across a series of survey items

examples.en: The simulated row illustrates straightlining by repeating the same answer across several items.
examples.zh: 模拟数据用一行多道题都选相同答案的情形说明「直线式作答」。

examples.en: We discussed why straightlining may occur even when responses are given thoughtfully.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么即使经过认真思考，也可能出现「直线式作答」。

words.enDefinition: Score obtained by adding the assigned points from specified items

examples.en: The worksheet shows how a summed score combines points from several related questions.
examples.zh: 习题展示了「加总分」如何把几道相关题目的分值相加。

examples.en: We compared the summed score with a score that gave some items extra weight.
examples.zh: 我们把「加总分」与某些题目权重更高的得分作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Score calculated by assigning specified relative contributions to its components

examples.en: The sample worksheet gives the reasoning section a larger contribution to the weighted score.
examples.zh: 样本习题中，推理部分在「加权分」中所占比重更大。

examples.en: We compared a weighted score with the simple sum from the same responses.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一组回答计算出的「加权分」与直接加总的分数。

words.enDefinition: Score based on items assessing one part of a broader measure

examples.en: The mock report lists a subscale score for each section of the questionnaire.
examples.zh: 模拟报告列出了问卷各部分的「分量表得分」。

examples.en: We discussed why a subscale score could differ from the pattern in the overall score.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么某个「分量表得分」的表现可能与总分的趋势不同。

words.enDefinition: Overall score formed by combining multiple measurements or component scores

examples.en: The sample report combines separate reasoning and vocabulary scores into a composite score.
examples.zh: 样本报告将独立的推理和词汇分数合成一个「合成分」。

examples.en: Our tutorial compares two different ways of constructing the same composite score.
examples.zh: 辅导课对比了构建同一「合成分」的两种方法。

words.enDefinition: Standardized score commonly scaled to mean fifty and standard deviation ten

examples.en: The class worksheet locates a T score on a scale with a labeled center.
examples.zh: 课堂习题在标出中心值的量尺上确定了一个「T分数」的位置。

examples.en: We checked that the T score column used the reporting scale described above.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「T分数」一栏是否采用上文描述的报告量尺。

words.enDefinition: Percentage of reference scores below a value, with ties treated by convention

examples.en: The fictional report gives a percentile rank alongside the number of questions answered correctly.
examples.zh: 虚构报告在答对题数旁边给出了一个「百分等级」。

examples.en: We checked which reference distribution the percentile rank came from in the sample table.
examples.zh: 我们核对了样表里的「百分等级」来自哪个参照分布。

words.enDefinition: Reference group whose scores provide a comparison for individual test scores

examples.en: The fictional manual describes the norm group before explaining how to interpret scores.
examples.zh: 虚构手册先描述「常模群体」，再说明如何解读分数。

examples.en: We compared the norm group in the workbook with the intended test population.
examples.zh: 我们把练习册里的「常模群体」与预定的测验对象作了对照。

words.enDefinition: Interpretation that compares a score with those of a designated reference group

examples.en: In the norm-referenced interpretation example, the score is compared with a reference distribution.
examples.zh: 在「常模参照解释」示例中，该得分和一个参照分布相比较。

examples.en: We discussed how norm-referenced interpretation differs from reporting a student's mastery of specific material.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「常模参照解释」与报告学生对特定内容的掌握程度有何不同。

words.enDefinition: Interpretation of performance relative to specified content, skills, or mastery criteria

examples.en: The sample report uses criterion-referenced interpretation to describe which tasks the learner can complete.
examples.zh: 样本报告用「标准参照解释」说明学习者能够完成哪些任务。

examples.en: We compared criterion-referenced interpretation with a summary that only ranked the fictional scores.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「标准参照解释」与只给虚构得分排名的摘要。

collocations: distinguish criterion-referenced interpretation from norm referencing

words.enDefinition: Group whose assessment results are used to establish norms or scoring references

examples.en: The manual identifies the standardization sample used to generate its reference scores.
examples.zh: 手册说明了用于生成参照分数的「标准化样本」。

examples.en: Our group discussed whether the standardization sample resembled the population in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了「标准化样本」是否与练习册里的目标总体相似。

words.enDefinition: Score references based on a particular school, institution, or local population

examples.en: The fictional school reports local norms alongside the reference values from a national sample.
examples.zh: 虚构学校在全国样本的参照值旁列出了「地方常模」。

examples.en: We checked why the percentile differed when the example used local norms.
examples.zh: 我们核对了为什么示例使用「地方常模」时，百分等级会不同。

words.enDefinition: Score references derived separately for people of different age groups

examples.en: The sample manual presents separate age norms for different groups in the fictional dataset.
examples.zh: 样本手册为虚构数据中的不同年龄组提供了各自的「年龄常模」。

examples.en: We discussed how age norms change the reference group used to interpret a score.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「年龄常模」如何改变解释分数时所用的参照群体。

words.enDefinition: Table giving score comparisons or conversions based on a reference group

examples.en: The workbook includes a norm table for converting example scores into percentile ranks.
examples.zh: 练习册给出一张「常模表」，用于把示例分数换算成百分等级。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the reference group described above the norm table.
examples.zh: 老师指出了「常模表」上方说明的参照群体。

collocations: locate a value in the norm table

words.enDefinition: Score that separates performance levels or classification categories on an assessment

examples.en: The example labels the cut score between two performance levels on the chart.
examples.zh: 示例在图表上标出两个表现等级之间的「分界分数」。

examples.en: We discussed why the two mock scores near the cut score were hard to distinguish.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么靠近「分界分数」的两个模拟分数很难区分。

words.enDefinition: Range of scores grouped together for reporting or interpretation

examples.en: The mock report groups similar scores in a single score band.
examples.zh: 模拟报告将相近的分数归入同一个「分数区间」。

examples.en: We noted that each score band in the table had its own description.
examples.zh: 我们注意到表里的每个「分数区间」都有对应的说明。

collocations: assign scores to a score band

words.enDefinition: Clustering near the lowest possible score that limits differentiation among low scorers

examples.en: The simulated test shows a floor effect because many scores cluster near zero.
examples.zh: 模拟测验中许多分数聚集在零分附近，出现了「地板效应」。

examples.en: We identified a floor effect when the hardest item set yielded nearly identical low scores.
examples.zh: 最难的一组题产生了几乎一样的低分，我们由此辨认出「地板效应」。

words.enDefinition: Clustering near the highest available score that limits differentiation among high scorers

examples.en: The class chart shows a ceiling effect because most scores are already near maximum.
examples.zh: 课堂图表中多数分数已经接近上限，因此出现了「天花板效应」。

examples.en: We examined whether a ceiling effect could hide improvement in the easier mock assessment.
examples.zh: 我们考察了在较简单的模拟测验中，「天花板效应」是否可能掩盖进步。

words.enDefinition: Property that scores from different forms carry the same intended meaning

examples.en: The tutor discussed score equivalence after showing two versions of the same fictional assessment.
examples.zh: 老师展示同一虚构测验的两个版本后，讨论了「分数等值性」。

examples.en: We checked whether the report provided any evidence of score equivalence across forms.
examples.zh: 我们查看报告是否提供了不同卷本之间的「分数等值性」证据。

words.enDefinition: Framework decomposing an observed test score into true score and random error

examples.en: The lecture uses classical test theory to distinguish stable differences from variation across repeated tests.
examples.zh: 讲座用「经典测验理论」区分稳定差异与多次测验之间的波动。

examples.en: We compared classical test theory with an approach that models responses to individual items.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「经典测验理论」与对单个题目的作答进行建模的方法。

words.enDefinition: Score actually obtained from a specified testing occasion and scoring procedure

examples.en: Each simulated row contains an observed score alongside the label for its testing occasion.
examples.zh: 模拟数据每行都有一个「观测分数」与对应的施测场次标签。

examples.en: The worksheet compares an observed score with the average across hypothetical repeated measurements.
examples.zh: 习题把一个「观测分数」与多次假设施测的平均值作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Expected score over hypothetical repetitions under the same defined measurement conditions

examples.en: The classical model defines a true score using the average across hypothetical repeated tests.
examples.zh: 经典模型用多次假设重复测验的平均值来定义「真分数」。

examples.en: We discussed why one observed score cannot establish the simulated person's true score.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么单次观测分数不能确定模拟人物的「真分数」。

collocations: distinguish an observed score from a true score

words.enDefinition: Difference between an observed score and its corresponding classical test theory expectation

examples.en: The simulation displays a negative error score when the obtained score falls below expectation.
examples.zh: 实际得到的分数低于期望值时，模拟会显示负的「误差分数」。

examples.en: We used the error score to describe the deviation in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们用「误差分数」描述虚构例子中的偏差。

words.enDefinition: Portion of observed score variability attributable to measurement error in a model

examples.en: The lecture separates error variance from stable differences between people in the model.
examples.zh: 讲座把「误差方差」与模型中个体之间的稳定差异分开讲解。

examples.en: We compared estimates of error variance for two versions of the fictional assessment.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构测验两个版本的「误差方差」估计值。

words.enDefinition: Consistency of test scores across replications under specified measurement conditions

examples.en: The report discusses score reliability using two comparable administrations of the fictional test.
examples.zh: 报告用两次可比较的虚构测验施测来讨论「分数信度」。

examples.en: We considered score reliability before deciding how much to read into small score differences.
examples.zh: 在判断应如何看待小幅分差之前，我们先考虑了「分数信度」。

words.enDefinition: Statistic quantifying score consistency for a specified design and measurement purpose

examples.en: The results table pairs each reliability coefficient with the replication design used to estimate it.
examples.zh: 结果表把每个「信度系数」与用于估计它的重复测量设计配列在一起。

examples.en: We asked which reliability coefficient was appropriate for the scores from two different raters.
examples.zh: 我们问，对于两位不同评分者给出的分数，哪种「信度系数」合适。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which item scores on a composite measure covary

examples.en: The article discusses internal consistency without assuming that correlated items prove a single factor.
examples.zh: 文章讨论了「内部一致性」，没有把题目分数相关当作单一因子的证明。

examples.en: We compared internal consistency estimates for two sets of items in the same workbook.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一本练习册中两组题目的「内部一致性」估计值。

words.enDefinition: Consistency of scores when the same measure is administered on different occasions

examples.en: The worksheet estimates test-retest reliability using the same fictional questionnaire on two occasions.
examples.zh: 习题用同一份虚构问卷在两次施测中的数据估计「重测信度」。

examples.en: We discussed how a longer gap might affect the estimate of test-retest reliability.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了更长的时间间隔可能如何影响「重测信度」估计值。

words.enDefinition: Consistency of scores obtained from different versions designed to measure the same attributes

examples.en: The class examines alternate-forms reliability using two versions with different items on the same skills.
examples.zh: 课堂用两份考查同样技能但题目不同的卷本来分析「复本信度」。

examples.en: Our sample report labels the relationship between the two forms as evidence for alternate-forms reliability.
examples.zh: 示例报告把两份卷本得分之间的关系列为「复本信度」的证据。

collocations: compare alternate-forms reliability with test-retest reliability

words.enDefinition: Internal consistency estimate based on scores from two parts of a test

examples.en: The workbook illustrates split-half reliability by comparing scores from odd and even items.
examples.zh: 练习册用比较奇数题和偶数题得分来说明「分半信度」。

examples.en: We discussed why split-half reliability might change when the test is split differently.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么采用不同分题方式时，「分半信度」可能会变化。

words.enDefinition: Consistency with which different raters distinguish the same targets using their ratings

examples.en: The tutorial estimates interrater reliability from two readers scoring the same fictional answers.
examples.zh: 辅导课用两位阅卷者给同一组虚构答案打出的分数估计「评分者间信度」。

examples.en: We discussed interrater reliability when the two raters ranked the scripts similarly.
examples.zh: 两位评分者对答卷排序相近时，我们讨论了「评分者间信度」。

words.enDefinition: Similarity of scores different raters assign to the same test responses

examples.en: The class checked interrater agreement by comparing the actual categories assigned by both readers.
examples.zh: 课堂通过对照两位阅卷者实际给出的类别来检查「评分者间一致度」。

examples.en: We distinguished interrater agreement from merely putting the fictional responses in the same order.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「评分者间一致度」与只是给虚构答案排出同样的顺序。

words.enDefinition: Internal consistency coefficient calculated from item variances and total score variance

examples.en: The article reports Cronbach's alpha for the items in each fictional subscale separately.
examples.zh: 文章分别报告了各个虚构分量表题目的「克朗巴赫α系数」。

examples.en: We discussed why a high Cronbach's alpha does not by itself establish a single factor.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「克朗巴赫α系数」较高也不足以证实单因子结构。

words.enDefinition: Model-based reliability coefficient using factor loadings and item error variances

examples.en: The exercise computes McDonald's omega from the factor model fitted to simulated item scores.
examples.zh: 练习根据拟合到模拟题目分数的因子模型计算「麦克唐纳ω系数」。

examples.en: We read the assumptions behind McDonald's omega before interpreting the worksheet's reliability estimate.
examples.zh: 解读习题的信度估计值之前，我们阅读了「麦克唐纳ω系数」所依据的假设。

words.enDefinition: Formula relating reliability to changes in length under parallel measurement assumptions

examples.en: The tutor used the Spearman-Brown formula to illustrate how test length affects estimated reliability.
examples.zh: 老师用「斯皮尔曼布朗公式」说明测验长度如何影响信度估计值。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions behind the Spearman-Brown formula before interpreting the predicted reliability.
examples.zh: 解读预测的信度之前，我们核对了「斯皮尔曼布朗公式」所依据的假设。

words.enDefinition: Family of statistics describing reliability or agreement of clustered or repeated measurements

examples.en: The worksheet uses an intraclass correlation coefficient to summarize ratings from several readers.
examples.zh: 习题用「组内相关系数」概括几位阅卷者给出的评分。

examples.en: Our group compared two versions of the intraclass correlation coefficient for the same simulated ratings.
examples.zh: 我们组对同一组模拟评分比较了两个版本的「组内相关系数」。

words.enDefinition: Coefficient of agreement between two categorical raters adjusted for expected chance agreement

examples.en: The worksheet reports Cohen's kappa for two graders assigning the same set of labels.
examples.zh: 习题给出了两名评分者使用同一套标签分类时的「科恩κ系数」。

examples.en: We discussed why Cohen's kappa can differ from the percentage of exact matches.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「科恩κ系数」可能不同于完全匹配的百分比。

words.enDefinition: Chance-adjusted agreement coefficient giving different weights to different category disagreements

examples.en: In our tutorial, weighted kappa treats adjacent rating disagreements differently from larger ones.
examples.zh: 辅导课上，「加权κ系数」对相邻等级的评分分歧和跨度更大的分歧区别处理。

examples.en: We compared weighted kappa with an index that treats all disagreements equally.
examples.zh: 我们将「加权κ系数」与对所有分歧同等处理的指标作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Estimated standard deviation of score errors under specified measurement conditions

examples.en: The score table gives one overall standard error of measurement beneath the hypothetical test results.
examples.zh: 分数表在假设测验结果下方给出一项总体的「测量标准误」。

examples.en: We used the standard error of measurement to discuss uncertainty around the simulated test score.
examples.zh: 我们用「测量标准误」来讨论模拟测验分数的不确定性。

collocations: estimate the standard error of measurement
report the standard error of measurement

words.enDefinition: Estimated score error standard deviation at a specified score or ability level

examples.en: The chart shows that the conditional standard error of measurement varies across the modeled score range.
examples.zh: 图表显示，「条件测量标准误」在模型的分数范围内有所变化。

examples.en: The worksheet reports a conditional standard error of measurement separately for each level on the scale.
examples.zh: 习题对量表的每个等级分别报告了一个「条件测量标准误」。

collocations: plot the conditional standard error of measurement
report the conditional standard error of measurement
compare conditional standard errors of measurement

words.enDefinition: Framework for separating sources of score variation across multiple measurement conditions

examples.en: The lecture uses generalizability theory to examine variation across tasks and raters together.
examples.zh: 讲座用「概化理论」同时考察不同任务和评分者带来的波动。

examples.en: We compared a generalizability theory example with an analysis assuming one undifferentiated error source.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一个「概化理论」示例和一个将误差来源合在一起分析的例子。

words.enDefinition: Source of measurement variation represented by conditions such as raters or occasions

examples.en: In the simulated design, raters are one measurement facet and tasks are another.
examples.zh: 在模拟设计中，评分者是一个「测量侧面」，任务是另一个。

examples.en: Our group marked each measurement facet in the practice diagram before reading the results.
examples.zh: 我们组先在练习图中标出每个「测量侧面」，再阅读结果。

words.enDefinition: Support from evidence and theory for interpreting scores for intended uses

examples.en: The lecture explains test score validity in relation to what the fictional scores are used for.
examples.zh: 讲座结合虚构分数的用途来解释「测验分数效度」。

examples.en: We discussed why test score validity could differ for two interpretations of the same scores.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么同一组分数用于两种解释时，「测验分数效度」可能不同。

words.enDefinition: Information bearing on whether intended interpretations or uses of scores are justified

examples.en: The workbook groups validity evidence by the questions it addresses about score interpretation.
examples.zh: 练习册按所要回答的分数解释问题对「效度证据」分类。

examples.en: We identified the validity evidence that speaks to the intended interpretation in the example.
examples.zh: 我们找出了示例中与预期解释有关的「效度证据」。

words.enDefinition: Reasoned case linking evidence and assumptions to an intended score interpretation

examples.en: The class read a validation argument for one proposed use of the fictional scores.
examples.zh: 课堂阅读了一份针对虚构分数某项拟定用途的「效度论证」。

examples.en: Our group identified one assumption in the validation argument that remained untested.
examples.zh: 我们组找出了「效度论证」中一个尚未检验的假设。

words.enDefinition: Support for interpreting a score as reflecting the intended theoretical attribute

examples.en: The research example discusses construct validity using evidence from several different simulated tasks.
examples.zh: 研究示例结合几项不同模拟任务的证据来讨论「构念效度」。

examples.en: We asked what would support construct validity for the particular interpretation proposed by the authors.
examples.zh: 我们问，哪些证据能够支持作者所提特定解释的「构念效度」。

words.enDefinition: Support for score interpretations based on representative coverage of the intended domain

examples.en: The class discussed content validity after checking the items against a fictional content outline.
examples.zh: 课堂先将各题与虚构内容提纲对照，再讨论「内容效度」。

examples.en: The worksheet considers content validity when one part of the domain receives no items.
examples.zh: 习题讨论了目标范围中的某一部分没有题目覆盖时的「内容效度」。

words.enDefinition: Support from relationships between test scores and a relevant external measure

examples.en: The worksheet examines criterion-related validity by comparing scores with performance on an independent task.
examples.zh: 习题将分数与独立任务的表现相比较，以考察「效标关联效度」。

examples.en: We discussed why the external variable mattered to the claim about criterion-related validity.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么这一外部变量关系到「效标关联效度」的论证。

words.enDefinition: Support from a relevant criterion measured at approximately the same time

examples.en: The class examines concurrent validity using mock scores from two measures collected together.
examples.zh: 课堂用大致同时取得的两种模拟测量分数考察「同时效度」。

examples.en: We identified the simultaneous measurement of both variables in the concurrent validity example.
examples.zh: 我们在「同时效度」示例中找出了两个同时测量的变量。

collocations: concurrent validity with an external measure

words.enDefinition: Support from the ability of test scores to predict a later criterion

examples.en: The workbook uses later simulated performance to illustrate evidence of predictive validity.
examples.zh: 练习册用后续的模拟表现来举例说明「预测效度」证据。

examples.en: We discussed predictive validity when the outcome was recorded several weeks after testing.
examples.zh: 当结果在测验几周后才记录时，我们讨论了「预测效度」。

words.enDefinition: Support from expected associations with other measures of the same or related constructs

examples.en: The example uses two measures of similar skills to illustrate convergent validity.
examples.zh: 示例用两项测量相似技能的工具来说明「聚合效度」。

examples.en: We discussed what pattern of correlations would support convergent validity in the dataset.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了数据中怎样的相关模式可以支持「聚合效度」。

words.enDefinition: Support from evidence that measures distinguish the intended construct from different constructs

examples.en: The workbook checks discriminant validity by including a measure of a different attribute.
examples.zh: 练习册通过加入测量不同属性的工具来考察「区分效度」。

examples.en: We discussed why two almost identical score patterns might weaken evidence of discriminant validity.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么几乎相同的两组分数模式可能削弱「区分效度」证据。

words.enDefinition: Additional useful information from a measure beyond that provided by existing measures

examples.en: The class asks whether the new score has incremental validity beyond two existing scores.
examples.zh: 课堂探讨新分数在两个既有分数之外是否具有「增量效度」。

examples.en: We compared two models to discuss incremental validity in the fictional assessment report.
examples.zh: 我们通过比较两个模型来讨论虚构测验报告中的「增量效度」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which a measure appears relevant to its intended purpose

examples.en: The worksheet discusses face validity by asking what the fictional test seems to measure.
examples.zh: 习题通过询问虚构测验看起来测什么来讨论「表面效度」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why face validity alone cannot justify the proposed interpretation of scores.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么仅凭「表面效度」不能证明预定的分数解释合理。

collocations: distinguish face validity from empirical evidence

words.enDefinition: Findings about whether respondents use the processes assumed by the score interpretation

examples.en: The class reviews response process evidence from fictional students discussing how they interpreted an item.
examples.zh: 课堂审阅了虚构学生讲述如何理解一道题时提供的「作答过程证据」。

examples.en: We identified which explanation counted as response process evidence for the proposed score use.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出哪项说明可作为预定分数用途的「作答过程证据」。

words.enDefinition: Findings about how relationships among items align with the proposed score structure

examples.en: The article presents internal structure evidence by checking whether items cluster as expected.
examples.zh: 文章通过检查题目是否按预期聚在一起提供「内部结构证据」。

examples.en: We read the fictional report's internal structure evidence alongside the matrix of item correlations.
examples.zh: 我们对照题目相关矩阵，阅读了虚构报告的「内部结构证据」。

words.enDefinition: Intended and unintended outcomes associated with assessment use and subsequent decisions

examples.en: The seminar considers the consequences of testing when a fictional report changes classroom decisions.
examples.zh: 研讨课考察了虚构报告改变课堂决策时的「测验后果」。

examples.en: Our class distinguished the consequences of testing from claims about what a score measures.
examples.zh: 课堂将「测验后果」与关于分数测量内容的主张区分开来。

collocations: evidence about the consequences of testing

words.enDefinition: Insufficient coverage of important aspects of the attribute an assessment targets

examples.en: The workbook illustrates construct underrepresentation with a reasoning assessment that omits visual problems.
examples.zh: 练习册用忽略视觉题的推理测验来说明「构念代表不足」。

examples.en: We discussed construct underrepresentation after identifying an entire skill missing from the sample blueprint.
examples.zh: 发现样本蓝图漏掉了一项完整技能后，我们讨论了「构念代表不足」。

words.enDefinition: Score variation attributable to influences outside the attribute being assessed

examples.en: The example considers construct-irrelevant variance when a reading requirement affects a pattern task.
examples.zh: 示例在阅读要求影响规律题作答时考虑了「构念无关方差」。

examples.en: We identified construct-irrelevant variance separately from genuine differences in the target skill.
examples.zh: 我们把「构念无关方差」与目标技能上的真实差异区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Coefficient linking an observed variable to a latent factor in a model

examples.en: The model assigns a factor loading to each arrow linking an item to a factor.
examples.zh: 模型为连接题目和因子的每个箭头分配一个「因子载荷」。

examples.en: We compared the factor loading for the same item across two simulated models.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一道题在两个模拟模型中的「因子载荷」。

words.enDefinition: Pattern specifying underlying factors and how observed items relate to them

examples.en: The article compares the factor structure of two fictional scales with similar content.
examples.zh: 文章比较了内容相似的两个虚构量表的「因子结构」。

examples.en: Our group drew the proposed factor structure before inspecting the loadings table.
examples.zh: 我们组先画出拟定的「因子结构」，再查看载荷表。

words.enDefinition: Method for investigating possible latent factor structures underlying observed variable relationships

examples.en: We used exploratory factor analysis to explore what structure might underlie the fictional items.
examples.zh: 我们用「探索性因子分析」探讨虚构题目可能具有怎样的潜在结构。

examples.en: The workbook presents exploratory factor analysis results without claiming that only one structure is possible.
examples.zh: 练习册给出了「探索性因子分析」结果，没有断言只有一种结构可能成立。

collocations: exploratory factor analysis of scale items

words.enDefinition: Method assessing how well a specified factor model fits observed relationships

examples.en: The worksheet uses confirmatory factor analysis to evaluate a proposed structure for simulated scores.
examples.zh: 习题用「验证性因子分析」评估为模拟分数设定的结构。

examples.en: We read the proposed factor model before interpreting the confirmatory factor analysis results.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读拟定的因子模型，再解读「验证性因子分析」的结果。

words.enDefinition: Substantial loading of an observed item on an additional factor

examples.en: The table shows a cross-loading for a question related to both proposed factors.
examples.zh: 表格显示，一道与两个拟定因子都有关的题目出现了「跨因子载荷」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the cross-loading was expected from the sample item's wording.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了从样题的措辞来看，这个「跨因子载荷」是否符合预期。

words.enDefinition: Evaluation of how individual assessment questions function in observed response data

examples.en: Our class uses item analysis to explain why two sample questions behave differently.
examples.zh: 课堂用「项目分析」解释两道样题为何表现不同。

examples.en: The workbook presents item analysis results before discussing the hypothetical test as a whole.
examples.zh: 练习册先给出「项目分析」结果，再讨论假想测验的整体表现。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which an assessment question is hard for respondents

examples.en: In the classroom example, item difficulty is summarized using the proportion answered correctly.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用答对比例来概括「项目难度」。

examples.en: We compared item difficulty for two questions covering the same fictional lesson.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两道考查同一虚构课程内容的题目的「项目难度」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which an item differentiates respondents at different measured trait levels

examples.en: The sample chart shows stronger item discrimination for one of the two questions.
examples.zh: 样本图表显示，两题中有一题的「项目区分度」更高。

examples.en: We discussed item discrimination separately from how many students answered the item correctly.
examples.zh: 我们把「项目区分度」和这道题有多少学生答对分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: Correlation of an item with the total score excluding that item

examples.en: The worksheet reports each corrected item-total correlation using a total that excludes the corresponding item.
examples.zh: 习题用剔除对应题目后的总分，报告各题的「校正题总相关」。

examples.en: We compared a corrected item-total correlation with its counterpart using the full total score.
examples.zh: 我们把「校正题总相关」与使用完整总分时得到的相关作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Examination of how respondents choose incorrect options on a selected-response item

examples.en: The tutor uses distractor analysis to discuss which wrong choices were selected in the simulation.
examples.zh: 老师用「干扰选项分析」讨论模拟中哪些错误选项被选中。

examples.en: We read the distractor analysis for a sample item with four possible answers.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了一道有四个作答选项的样题的「干扰选项分析」。

words.enDefinition: Framework relating item response probabilities to latent traits and item characteristics

examples.en: The lecture introduces item response theory through probability curves for two hypothetical questions.
examples.zh: 讲座用两道假想题目的概率曲线来介绍「项目反应理论」。

examples.en: We compared item response theory with a framework focused mainly on total scores.
examples.zh: 我们将「项目反应理论」与主要关注总分的框架作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Graph relating the probability of a scored response to latent trait level

examples.en: The item characteristic curve rises as the model's estimated skill increases in the example.
examples.zh: 在该示例中，「项目特征曲线」随模型估计技能水平的提高而上升。

examples.en: We compared the slope of each item characteristic curve using the same horizontal scale.
examples.zh: 我们用相同刻度的横轴对比了各条「项目特征曲线」的斜率。

collocations: shape of an item characteristic curve

words.enDefinition: Graph of the probability of selecting a response category across trait levels

examples.en: The worksheet plots one category response curve for each possible answer category on the scale.
examples.zh: 习题为量表的每个可选答案类别画了一条「类别反应曲线」。

examples.en: We located the peak of the category response curve for the middle option.
examples.zh: 我们找出了中间选项的「类别反应曲线」的峰值。

collocations: peak of a category response curve

words.enDefinition: Model-based quantity reflecting how precisely an item measures at a trait level

examples.en: The graph shows item information peaking near the middle of the simulated scale.
examples.zh: 图表显示，「项目信息量」在模拟量表中部附近达到峰值。

examples.en: We compared item information for two questions that had different response curves.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两道反应曲线不同的题目的「项目信息量」。

collocations: item information at a trait level

words.enDefinition: Function describing the measurement precision of a test across latent trait levels

examples.en: The test information function peaks above the center of the scale in this illustration.
examples.zh: 在这幅示意图中，「测验信息函数」在高于量尺中心的位置达到峰值。

examples.en: We compared the test information function for two invented assessments with different item mixtures.
examples.zh: 我们比较了题目构成不同的两份虚构测验的「测验信息函数」。

collocations: peak of the test information function

words.enDefinition: Estimation of item parameters from response data under a measurement model

examples.en: The workbook uses synthetic responses to illustrate item calibration under a specified model.
examples.zh: 练习册用合成作答数据说明在已设定模型下的「项目校准」。

examples.en: We read the item calibration results before comparing the difficulty estimates across items.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「项目校准」结果，再比较各题的难度估计。

words.enDefinition: Item parameter locating the response curve along the latent trait scale

examples.en: The class graph links a larger difficulty parameter to a curve farther right.
examples.zh: 课堂图表将较大的「难度参数」与位置更靠右的曲线联系起来。

examples.en: We compared the difficulty parameter for two questions on the same synthetic scale.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一合成量尺上两道题的「难度参数」。

words.enDefinition: Item parameter governing how sharply response probability changes with trait level

examples.en: The simulated curves have different slopes because their discrimination parameter values differ.
examples.zh: 模拟曲线的斜率不同，因为它们的「区分度参数」取值不同。

examples.en: We read the discrimination parameter for each question from the fictional model output.
examples.zh: 我们从虚构模型的输出中读出每道题的「区分度参数」。

words.enDefinition: An item response model parameter representing the lower asymptote of the probability of a correct response.

examples.en: The sample model uses a guessing parameter to represent the curve's lower limit.
examples.zh: 示例模型用「猜测参数」表示答对概率曲线的下限。

examples.en: We discussed why a guessing parameter does not identify who actually guessed.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「猜测参数」不能辨认出谁确实是猜的。

collocations: lower asymptote determined by the guessing parameter

words.enDefinition: Item response model with item difficulty and common discrimination across binary items

examples.en: The tutorial fits a Rasch model to invented answers from a short assessment.
examples.zh: 辅导课把「拉施模型」拟合到一份简短测验的虚构作答数据。

examples.en: We compared the Rasch model curves while keeping their slopes the same.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「拉施模型」曲线，各条曲线的斜率保持相同。

words.enDefinition: Binary response model allowing item difficulty and discrimination to vary

examples.en: The two-parameter logistic model allows the two simulated items to have different slopes.
examples.zh: 「双参数逻辑斯蒂模型」允许两道模拟题的曲线斜率不同。

examples.en: We compared a two-parameter logistic model with a model using one common slope.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一个「双参数逻辑斯蒂模型」与采用共同斜率的模型。

collocations: item estimates from a two-parameter logistic model
assumptions of the two-parameter logistic model

words.enDefinition: Binary response model with item difficulty, discrimination, and a lower asymptote

examples.en: In the three-parameter logistic model, each simulated curve can approach a nonzero lower limit.
examples.zh: 在「三参数逻辑斯蒂模型」中，各条模拟曲线可以逼近一个非零下限。

examples.en: Our tutorial identifies the extra parameter in the three-parameter logistic model fitted to synthetic responses.
examples.zh: 辅导课指出了拟合到合成作答的「三参数逻辑斯蒂模型」里多出的参数。

collocations: estimates from a three-parameter logistic model

words.enDefinition: Item response model using cumulative probabilities for ordered response categories

examples.en: The workbook uses a graded response model for the fictional scale's ordered answer categories.
examples.zh: 练习册对虚构量表中的有序答案类别采用了「等级反应模型」。

examples.en: We discussed how a graded response model describes the probability of choosing higher categories.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「等级反应模型」如何描述选择较高类别的概率。

collocations: assumptions of the graded response model
thresholds in a graded response model

words.enDefinition: Rasch-family model relating probabilities of adjacent ordered score categories to ability

examples.en: The exercise uses a partial credit model for items scored zero, one, or two.
examples.zh: 练习对计零、一或二分的题目使用了「部分计分模型」。

examples.en: We identified which steps the partial credit model associated with moving between adjacent scores.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出了「部分计分模型」中对应于相邻分值转换的步骤参数。

collocations: thresholds in a partial credit model

words.enDefinition: Degree of agreement between observed item responses and model expectations

examples.en: The worksheet compares observed and predicted responses to discuss item fit for one question.
examples.zh: 习题对比一道题的实际作答与预测作答，讨论其「项目拟合」。

examples.en: Our group checked item fit before interpreting the model values in the table.
examples.zh: 我们组先检查「项目拟合」，再解读表中的模型数值。

words.enDefinition: Assumption that item responses are independent conditional on the modeled trait levels

examples.en: The tutor explains local independence by distinguishing residual links from shared ability effects.
examples.zh: 老师通过区分残差关联和共同能力的影响来解释「局部独立性」。

examples.en: We looked for violations of local independence in the shared passage example.
examples.zh: 我们在共用同一篇材料的题目示例中寻找违反「局部独立性」的迹象。

words.enDefinition: Assumption that one latent dimension accounts for the measured item responses

examples.en: The class checks unidimensionality before interpreting scores using a single skill dimension.
examples.zh: 课堂在用单一技能维度解读分数之前，先检查「单维性」。

examples.en: We discussed unidimensionality after comparing one-factor and two-factor models for the fictional items.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构题目的单因子和双因子模型，接着讨论了「单维性」。

words.enDefinition: Statistical adjustment intended to make scores from comparable test forms interchangeable

examples.en: The fictional testing program uses test equating to account for differences in form difficulty.
examples.zh: 虚构测验项目用「测验分数等值」处理不同卷本难度上的差异。

examples.en: We discussed test equating after noticing that one mock form was slightly harder.
examples.zh: 注意到一份模拟卷稍难后，我们讨论了「测验分数等值」。

words.enDefinition: Common item used to link scores or parameters across forms or groups

examples.en: The chart marks an anchor item that appears on both versions of the test.
examples.zh: 图表标出一道在两个测验卷本上都出现的「锚题」。

examples.en: We discussed why an anchor item should function comparably in both synthetic samples.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么一道「锚题」在两个合成样本中的表现应当可比。

words.enDefinition: Principle of equitable access and appropriate score interpretations across intended groups

examples.en: The seminar treats test fairness as involving both access and interpretation of scores.
examples.zh: 研讨课认为「测验公平性」既涉及参与测验的条件，也涉及分数解释。

examples.en: Our group discussed test fairness using a fictional test that relied on unfamiliar language.
examples.zh: 我们组用一份使用陌生语言的虚构测验来讨论「测验公平性」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which intended respondents can take a test without irrelevant barriers

examples.en: The practice report discusses test accessibility when the screen layout obscures instructions.
examples.zh: 练习报告讨论了屏幕布局遮住说明时的「测验可及性」。

examples.en: We considered test accessibility separately from differences in the skill being measured.
examples.zh: 我们把「测验可及性」与被测技能的差异分开考虑。

words.enDefinition: Adjustment reducing an irrelevant barrier while preserving the intended measurement construct

examples.en: The example describes a test accommodation that makes the fictional instructions easier to access.
examples.zh: 示例描述了一项让参与者更容易获取虚构测验的说明的「测验便利安排」。

examples.en: We discussed how a test accommodation might preserve access without changing the target skill.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「测验便利安排」如何在不改变目标技能的情况下保障参与。

words.enDefinition: Modification of an assessment for use in a new linguistic or cultural context

examples.en: The class examines test adaptation across two fictional language versions of a questionnaire.
examples.zh: 课堂考察了一份问卷的两种虚构语言版本之间的「测验调适」。

examples.en: We discussed test adaptation as involving more than translating response options word for word.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「测验调适」并不只是逐字翻译作答选项。

words.enDefinition: Equivalence of measurement relationships across specified groups, conditions, or occasions

examples.en: The paper describes measurement invariance across two invented groups with different average scores.
examples.zh: 论文描述了平均分不同的两个虚构组之间的「测量不变性」。

examples.en: We discussed measurement invariance before interpreting the differences in scores between those groups.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「测量不变性」，再解读这些组的分数差异。

words.enDefinition: Same pattern of item-to-factor relationships across groups or measurement occasions

examples.en: The exercise checks configural invariance by comparing which items load on each factor.
examples.zh: 练习通过对照每个因子对应哪些题目，检查「形态不变性」。

examples.en: We discussed why configural invariance does not require equal numerical loadings across groups.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「形态不变性」不要求各组的载荷数值相等。

words.enDefinition: Equality of corresponding factor loadings across groups with a shared factor structure

examples.en: The metric invariance model constrains loadings to be equal in both simulated groups.
examples.zh: 「载荷不变性」模型将两个模拟组的载荷约束为相等。

examples.en: We compared the model with metric invariance against one allowing loadings to differ.
examples.zh: 我们将设有「载荷不变性」约束的模型与允许载荷不同的模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: In a factor model, equality of item intercepts or thresholds across groups along with equality of corresponding factor loadings.

examples.en: The workbook shows scalar invariance after adding equality constraints on item intercepts.
examples.zh: 练习册在增加题目截距相等的约束后展示了「截距不变性」。

examples.en: We discussed scalar invariance using continuous indicators in the fictional factor model.
examples.zh: 我们用虚构因子模型中的连续指标讨论了「截距不变性」。

words.enDefinition: Equality of residual variances in addition to scalar measurement invariance

examples.en: The final model adds equal residual variances for the strict invariance comparison.
examples.zh: 最终模型加入残差方差相等的约束，以便进行「严格不变性」比较。

examples.en: We checked what the strict invariance model assumed beyond the previous model.
examples.zh: 我们检查了与上一个模型相比，「严格不变性」模型多了哪些假设。

words.enDefinition: Measurement equivalence after allowing some parameters to vary across comparison groups

examples.en: The fictional example illustrates partial measurement invariance by allowing one item intercept to differ.
examples.zh: 虚构示例允许一道题的截距不同，从而说明「部分测量不变性」。

examples.en: We discussed partial measurement invariance after noticing that most constraints fit the synthetic data.
examples.zh: 我们发现大部分约束与合成数据吻合，随后讨论了「部分测量不变性」。

words.enDefinition: Different item response probabilities across groups matched on the measured trait

examples.en: The workbook checks differential item functioning by comparing item probabilities at equal trait levels.
examples.zh: 练习册通过对比相同特质水平下的题目作答概率来检查「项目功能差异」。

examples.en: We discussed why a group score difference alone cannot establish differential item functioning.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么仅凭组间分数差异无法确定存在「项目功能差异」。

words.enDefinition: Group effect on item responses without an interaction with measured trait level

examples.en: The synthetic example shows uniform differential item functioning with parallel logit curves across groups.
examples.zh: 合成示例用不同组的平行对数优势曲线来展示「一致性项目功能差异」。

examples.en: We checked whether the model for uniform differential item functioning included a trait interaction.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「一致性项目功能差异」模型是否包含特质交互项。

collocations: test for uniform differential item functioning
evidence of uniform differential item functioning

words.zhGloss: 非一致性项目功能差异
words.enDefinition: Group effect on item responses that varies with measured trait level
acceptedZhAnswers: 非一致性项目功能差异
非均一性项目功能差异

examples.en: The exercise illustrates nonuniform differential item functioning because the group difference changes with trait level.
examples.zh: 习题中的组间差异随特质水平变化，体现了「非一致性项目功能差异」。

examples.en: The sample plot illustrates nonuniform differential item functioning even though the group curves never cross.
examples.zh: 尽管两组曲线从未相交，样本图依然展示了「非一致性项目功能差异」。

collocations: test for nonuniform differential item functioning
evidence of nonuniform differential item functioning

words.enDefinition: Group differences in expected test scores at equivalent latent trait levels

examples.en: Our group examined differential test functioning after combining the expected scores across sample items.
examples.zh: 我们组先合并各道样题的期望得分，再考察「测验功能差异」。

examples.en: The worksheet distinguishes differential test functioning from a group effect on a single item.
examples.zh: 习题区分了「测验功能差异」与组别对单个题目的影响。

collocations: compare differential test functioning across score levels

words.enDefinition: Systematic item disadvantage attributable to factors unrelated to the intended construct

examples.en: The class treated item bias as a question about causes, not just statistical patterns.
examples.zh: 课堂把「项目偏差」看作一个涉及成因的问题，不能仅凭统计模式判断。

examples.en: We discussed item bias after noticing that the fictional item required unrelated background knowledge.
examples.zh: 发现虚构题目要求无关的背景知识后，我们讨论了「项目偏差」。

words.enDefinition: Differences across groups in how test scores predict an external criterion

examples.en: The exercise illustrates differential prediction when two simulated groups have different prediction lines.
examples.zh: 习题用两个模拟组各有不同预测线的情形说明「差异预测」。

examples.en: We discussed differential prediction in relation to an external outcome in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我们结合练习册中的一个外部结果变量讨论了「差异预测」。

words.enDefinition: Degree to which translated test wording preserves the intended original meaning

examples.en: The tutorial discusses translation equivalence after comparing the meaning of two invented translations.
examples.zh: 辅导课比较了两个虚构译本的含义，随后讨论「翻译等值性」。

examples.en: We distinguished translation equivalence from evidence that the two language versions yield comparable scores.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「翻译等值性」与两个语言版本能否产生可比较分数的证据。

words.enDefinition: Comparable meaning of the underlying attribute across groups or cultural settings

examples.en: The seminar asks whether construct equivalence holds when the same term has different meanings.
examples.zh: 研讨课探讨同一个术语含义不同时是否具有「构念等值性」。

examples.en: We discussed construct equivalence before interpreting group differences on the fictional classroom scale.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「构念等值性」，再解读虚构课堂量表上的组间差异。
